text:
alex: Quick heads-up — quiet window starts in 45m for the EU midnight change. I’ll run a tactical sweep in 30m. Locking pins at T-30 unless an embargo exception is filed.
maria: On it. Can you confirm which routes are covered by the hard pin? I have a hotfix that might need exemption.
sam: Link to summary + release notes: https://internal/redwood/releases/2026-03-21-eu-slice — hotfix touches /api/embeddings only.
jamie: +1 on embargo exception path. If it’s only embeddings and under 5% traffic, we can do an embargoed hotpatch with manual approval.
alex: Good call. Embargo exceptions must list rollback owner + deploybot pin override code. Post details here by T-25.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary lanes will be pinned to v3.2.0-canary at T-30. If canary error rate > 1.5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows, automatic rollback to v3.1.9 will trigger. See /deploy status.
tess: I’ll be rollback owner for the embeddings path (pager: tess). If we approve embargo, I’ll own rollback and validation checks.
maria: Embargo request: hotfix-id 2026-03-21-emb-007 — changes a caching ttl for embeddings. Risk: slightly higher memory usage for small batch jobs. Validation plan: smoke + 5m real-traffic shadow with rate-limit.
alex: Approved conditionally. Tess to confirm readiness and post smoke webhook. Manual pin override token: OVERRIDE-EMB-42 (post to ops vault only).
jamie: Smoke script: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/embeddings -d '{"text": "smoke test"}' -H "x-test": "smoke"
```
Watchpoint: latency p95 < 300ms and OOMs == 0.
tess: Running smoke now, pushing to shadow for 5m. Will report results in 3m.
maria: FYI I updated release notes with the exemption entry and added rollback steps.
tess: Smoke ✅. p95=210ms, no OOM across 5m. Ready to approve embargoed hotpatch.
alex: Ok we’ll allow embargo. Timeline: embargoed deploy at T-20, monitoring until T+10. Tess owns rollback. Sam please add an entry in the launch chat to surface metrics.
sam: Added dashboard link and pinned it in the channel. Also added an automated alert: embeddings_error_rate > 0.8% triggers @oncall.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Embargoed hotpatch scheduled: 6154322170 -> target hosts: eu-embed-{01..06}. Canary -> full after 4m steady metrics.
jamie: Noted. Ops checklist recap: 1) pins locked (except embargo override) 2) deploybot canary + monitor 3) rollback owner assigned 4) release notes + ticket linked 5) post-mortem owner: alex.
alex: Thanks team. If anything regresses, immediate rollback command: `/deploy rollback v3.1.9 --target eu-embed` — Tess will run it. :shield:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 6154322170. Initial health OK. Continuing monitor (4m window).
tess: Monitoring live — metrics look clean so far. Will escalate if error spike >0.5%.
alex: Final reminder — quiet window rules: no non-exempt merges, no routing changes. If you need an exception, tag me and include rollback owner & smoke results.
sam: Copy. Good luck :rocket:
